title: [BUG] Gradient norm abnormally increases when training with ZeRO-0
author: wxhcore

comments.author: wxhcore
comments.body:
Hi @tohtana,

I'd like to sync with you about a potential issue I just encountered today while testing my own project, [BumbleCore](https://github.com/wxhcore/bumblecore)—a training framework that implements the training loop manually and relies directly on DeepSpeed at a low level.

During testing, I noticed **some unexpected behavior under ZeRO-0 mode**. However, considering that ZeRO-0 is essentially equivalent to standard DDP—and given that the community rarely uses or tests ZeRO-0 specifically (most either use plain DDP or go straight to ZeRO-2/3)—there’s very limited validation around it.

As I’m currently short on time and unable to thoroughly investigate whether this stems from a DeepSpeed bug, a misconfiguration, or an oversight in my own integration, I wanted to proactively share this with you. Would you be able to help assess whether **this might be a noteworthy underlying issue**?

Thanks so much!

comments.author: tohtana
comments.body: Hi @wxhcore, thank you for reporting! Yes, the code actually had an issue. #7839 should address it.

comments.author: wxhcore
comments.body:
> 你好[@wxhcore](https://github.com/wxhcore)感谢您的反馈！是的，代码确实存在问题。[#7839](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/7839)应该可以解决这个问题。

I'm glad this was indeed a bug, thank you so much for fixing it!
